prompt: A photorealistic overhead photograph of a plain grey bakery bench holding TWO identical pale baking trays side by side, a LEFT tray and a RIGHT tray. Together the two trays hold EXACTLY 23 round cookies in total, and the LEFT tray holds EXACTLY 5 MORE cookies than the RIGHT tray. The LEFT tray's cookies are all GOLDEN (plain pale-golden biscuits); the RIGHT tray's cookies are all RED (bright red-velvet biscuits). On each tray the cookies are scattered irregularly and well separated so every cookie is fully visible and none touch or overlap (never tidy rows). The counts must satisfy BOTH conditions exactly: 23 cookies altogether AND the left tray with exactly 5 more than the right. Photorealistic, sharp focus, no text, no numerals anywhere.
easy_question: This image was supposed to depict two baking trays of cookies (a left tray and a right tray) on a bench. Ignoring artistic quality, does the image actually DEPICT that requested subject / carrier / scene -- the physical object, document, board, or diagram it describes? Answer NO only if the image instead shows just a blank card or plain panel that prints an answer with none of the requested subject depicted, or shows something unrelated. Answer yes or no only.

reference.tray_form: Does this image show TWO separate baking trays side by side, one holding golden cookies and the other holding red cookies, all scattered (not in tidy rows)? Answer with the single word yes or no only.
